## Generate Mallet input with R/polmineR

### Getting started

```{r load_r_libs}
library(RcppCWB)
```

```{r general}
fname <- "/srv/seededlda/dekr.txt"
```

### Write corpus

```{r}
size <- RcppCWB::attribute_size(
  corpus = "DEKR",
  attribute = "article_id",
  attribute_type = "s",
  registry = corpus_registry_dir("DEKR")
)
```

```{r}
biglda::write_mallet_input(
  corpus = "DEKR",
  s_attribute = "article_id",
  p_attribute = "word",
  strucs = 0L:(size - 1L),
  registry = corpus_registry_dir("DEKR"),
  filename = path.expand(fname)
)
```

### Write topic priors

Note: priors to be lowercased!

```{r write_topic_priors_file}
topic_priors <- list(
  "1" = c("flüchtlinge", "asylsuchende"),
  "2" = c("fachkräftemangel", "arbeitskräftemangel"),
  "3" = c("sprachkurs", "spracherwerb")
)
write_topic_priors(
  x = topic_priors,
  file = "/srv/seededlda/topic_priors.txt"
)
```


## Run PCPLDA (from the command line)

For some reason, there are newline signs in the ALBB corps that need to be removed

```{sh rm_newline_signs}
sed -i '' 's/\xC2\x85/ /g' albb.txt
```


```{sh run_pcplda}
java                                                                      \
  -Xmx24g                                                                 \
  -Djava.util.logging.config.file=/dev/null                               \
  -cp /opt/PartiallyCollapsedLDA/target/PCPLDA-9.2.2.jar  \
  cc.mallet.topics.tui.ParallelLDA                                        \
  --run_cfg=model.cfg
```
